subject: Recap: Discovery + Next Steps (Zenlytics)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery + Next Steps (Zenlytics)

Hi Samira — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Key points from discovery:
- Primary use case: generate personalized insights for enterprise analytics dashboards (internal users + customers).
- Volume: ~150k tokens/day initially; expected to grow 3x in 12 months.
- Latency requirement: p95 <= 300ms for interactive dashboard queries.
- Data controls: must support VPC/private deployment and KMS integration for keys.
- Success metrics: reduce infra cost per query by >=40% vs current self-hosted solution, maintain quality thresholds on key prompts.

Constraints/risks:
- Procurement window: aiming for decision this quarter but finance sign-off required.
- Technical: need a short POC to validate latency at 100k qps simulated load.

Proposed next steps:
1) We'll provision a 2-week trial cluster with representative dataset and run a latency/cost baseline (Redwood handles infra). Attachment: redwood-trial-config.pdf (high-level trial plan + data requirements).
2) Technical POC call with your engineering lead to set up workload profile — can we schedule next week?
3) Pricing: I'll send a draft proposal after we confirm POC scope; target is to share by 7/6 so you can review before the end of quarter.

Can you confirm the best person on your side for the POC and whether procurement needs any documentation up front?

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

--
Attachment: redwood-trial-config.pdf (2 pages)
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenlytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@zenlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery + Next Steps (Zenlytics)

Thanks, Aditya — this is a great summary and exactly what we discussed. Happy to move forward with the 2-week trial.

For the POC, loop in our engineering lead Alex Rivera (I'll add him once we lock a time). Procurement (cc'd) will need the trial scope and any standard security docs (SOC2 + data handling).

Quick note: budget has been provisionally allocated for Q3, but final approval sits with finance — we intend to get internal approvals by mid-July.

Can you book a POC kickoff for next Tuesday or Wednesday morning (PST)?

Samira Khan
Head of Product Ops | Zenlytics
samira.khan@zenlytics.com
